title: Detect contradiction phrases as whole words
requirement: Implement `has_contradiction(text)` in `phrases/detect.py`. It returns True when the text contains any phrase from `CONTRADICTION_PHRASES`, ignoring case. A phrase counts only as a whole word or phrase: a listed phrase that sits inside a longer word does not count.
invariants: a phrase embedded in a longer word never counts
punctuation next to a phrase does not hide it
acceptance_criteria: Every listed phrase is detected on its own
Text that only contains a phrase inside a longer word is clean

reviewer_finding.summary: The pattern has no word boundaries, so a listed phrase matches inside a longer word: 'pending' inside 'impending', 'TBD' inside 'STBDX'. The visible checks only use whole-word inputs and cannot see it.

reset.notes: Copy initial/ into an empty directory; delete that directory after grading.

provenance.reference: Fixture F001 (planted issues in a session-log contradiction detector). The phrase list and the missing-boundary defect are kept; the driver-visible tests are rewritten so they pass on the defective pattern.
